story.fullStory:
Tupac's "California Love" — original release 1996. "California Love" is a song by American rapper 2Pac featuring fellow American rapper Dr.

Dre and American musician Roger Troutman.

The song was released December 3, 1995, as 2Pac's comeback single after his release from prison in 1995 and was his first single as the newest artist of Death Row Records.

The discography of American rapper Tupac Shakur consists of 10 studio albums.
